title: SemanTok: Predictable Semantic Tokens for Efficient Autoregressive Video Generation
abstract: arXiv:2610.00686v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Recent video-based world models pair the scalability of autoregressive (AR) prediction with the visual quality of diffusion models. The choice of scene tokenizer is paramount for the optimal performance of each of these, both in terms of fidelity and semantics. Flexible-length, coarse-to-fine tokenizers yield exactly that: the first coarse tokens carry the clip's global semantics while later tokens further specify details. Existing flexible tokenizers only apply a representation-alignment (REPA) loss on early decoder hidden states, a target the decoder can partly meet from its noised input instead. We introduce SemanTok, a flexible video tokenizer that feeds frozen DINO features into its encoder and adds lightweight heads that reconstruct them from each retained token prefix alone. SemanTok achieves high semantic alignment and video fidelity at every AR model size: a 201M SemanTok AR model matches or beats a VideoFlexTok AR model $3.4\

translated_title: SemanTok：面向高效自回归视频生成的可预测语义标记
translated_abstract: 近期基于视频的世界模型将自回归（AR）预测的可扩展性与扩散模型的视觉质量相结合。场景分词器的选择对于二者的最优性能至关重要，无论在保真度还是语义方面。灵活长度、由粗到细的分词器恰好能够提供这一点：最初的粗粒度标记承载视频片段的全局语义，而后续标记则进一步明确细节。现有的灵活分词器仅在解码器早期的隐藏状态上应用表征对齐（REPA）损失，而这一目标解码器可以从其带噪输入中部分达成。我们提出SemanTok，这是一种灵活的视频分词器，它将冻结的DINO特征输入其编码器，并添加轻量级头，仅从每个保留的标记前缀重建这些特征。SemanTok在每个AR模型规模上都实现了高语义对齐和视频保真度：一个201M参数的SemanTok AR模型匹配或超越了VideoFlexTok AR模型3.4倍（摘要原文在此处截断）。
tldr: SemanTok通过将冻结的DINO特征输入分词器编码器，并利用轻量级头从每个保留的标记前缀重建语义特征，实现了高语义对齐与视频保真度，使仅201M参数的自回归模型即可匹敌或超越约3.4倍规模的VideoFlexTok模型。
en_tdlr: SemanTok achieves high semantic alignment and video fidelity at every AR model size by feeding frozen DINO features into its tokenizer encoder and reconstructing them from each retained token prefix, enabling a 201M AR model to match or beat a 3.4x larger VideoFlexTok model.
